facts: Unfortunately, your claim for home health care expenses is not covered by your policy.
The policy explicitly states that the cover for home health care expenses is not available on a reimbursement basis, and requires pre-authorization by the company, which is not met in this case.

cited_clauses.quote: Home Health Care The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred by the Insured Person on availing treatment at Home during the Policy Year, if prescribed in writing by the treating Medical Practitioner, provided that: a. The treatment in normal course would require In-patient Care at a Hospital, and be admissible under Section B-1.1 (Hospitalization Expenses). b. The treatment is pre-authorized by the Company as per procedure given under Claims Procedure - Section E-1. c. Records of the treatment administered, duly signed by the treating Medical Practitioner, are maintained for each day of the Home treatment. This Cover is not available on reimbursement basis.

reasoning: The policy explicitly states that the cover for home health care expenses is not available on a reimbursement basis, and requires pre-authorization by the company, which is not met in this case.
relief_sought: I respectfully request that the claim be reconsidered and honored.
document_checklist: Copy of the claim rejection letter
Medical bills, prescriptions and investigation reports
Earlier correspondence with the insurer, including any grievance acknowledgement
deadline_note: A complaint to the Insurance Ombudsman needs a written representation to the insurer first; it must then be made within one year of the insurer's rejection, or of one month after the representation was sent (Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, Rule 14(3), checked against the published text as amended till 09.11.2023; later amendments not checked). Confirm with the Ombudsman office before relying on a date, and compute dates with the deadline tool.
